<action type="say">
I can do that and get multiple quotes for you.

To start, I need a few details:

1) Location  
• Full service address (or at least city + ZIP/postcode)

2) What’s being done exactly  
• Is this: (a) remove old faucet + install new one, or (b) install on a new sink with no existing faucet?  
• Type of sink: 1-hole, 3-hole, or not sure?  
• Do you already have the new faucet (brand/model if you know), or should quotes include supplying the faucet?  
• Any under-sink shutoff valves that look corroded/old, or issues like low water pressure, leaks, garbage disposal attached, etc.?

3) Timing and urgency  
• Is this an emergency, same_day, or routine job?  
• Preferred date(s) (YYYY-MM-DD) and whether you prefer morning/afternoon/evening.

4) Access & constraints (optional but helpful)  
• Apartment/condo or single-family home?  
• Any parking or access issues (elevator, street parking only, etc.)?

Reply with those details in a quick bullet list, and I’ll use them to pull a set of quotes you can compare.</action>
